meta.label: Data
meta.value: Angel One 1-hour stock-futures candles Oct-2022 to Oct-2026, 181 F&O stocks, front month (research data, branch exp/stock-call-audit)

meta.label: Rules
meta.value: SELL only when the stock's daily trend is already down (EMA20 < EMA50, close < EMA50, previous day). Signal at the candle close, entry next candle's open (skipped if > 0.5 ATR away), stop checked first inside a candle, never held through expiry, 2x costs. One call at a time per stock and setup.

meta.label: Lot
meta.value: P&L per lot uses TODAY's NSE lot size (18-Nov-2026); older lots differed, so old ₹ figures are indicative.
